node: Staples input chains: food ingredients, protein, beverages, packaging, cold chain, and wholesale distribution
summary: Expanded the universe toward less-obvious public-market exposures around staples input chains. The strongest direct mappings are temperature-controlled warehouse capacity, cold-chain equipment, food and beverage processing automation, shelf-stable food packaging, and specialty ingredient suppliers. The key Serenity question is not simply whether staples volumes are defensive, but which upstream or infrastructure suppliers can preserve pricing, utilization, or replacement demand when CPG brands and retailers face grocery inflation, private-label trade-down, labor pressure, input volatility, and food-waste reduction mandates.
